title: Entrys in the treatment menu only partially visible
body:
In the treatment menu, entries are only partially visible and can therefore no longer be deleted (at least in portrait mode). See attached screenshot.

![Screenshot_20220225_223142_info nightscout androidaps](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62606176/156000890-b91e61b1-169d-421e-b392-2d6e28fc6264.jpg)



Edit: Even when I set Font size to "small" I don't see fhe full line:

![Screenshot_20220228_152901_info nightscout androidaps](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62606176/156000716-ae39b601-75b5-48bb-b508-8f792087cc39.jpg)
